notes.title: The Last Reunion v1.4 Patch
notes.content:
📢 Images have been added to each character’s ending scene!In this v1.4 update, dedicated images have been included for every NPC’s ending.

Now, when you reach the ending, you can experience a more immersive and emotional moment through the character-specific images.


We will continue to improve and update the game to provide a better play experience.
Thank you.

notes.title: The Last Reunion v1.3 Patch
notes.content:
🎉 Steam Achievements are now available!The latest update adds full support for Steam achievements.
Unlock unique endings and earn achievements as you uncover the secrets of The Last Reunion.


Added: Steam Achievements (3 endings) 

Thank you for playing and supporting our game!

notes.title: The Last Reunion v1.2 Patch
notes.content:
🌍 New Language Support Added!
We’re excited to announce that The Last Reunion is now available in both English and Japanese!

Players can now enjoy the full mystery experience in their preferred language. You can switch languages via the game’s settings menu on Steam.

Whether you're investigating clues in English or following the story in Japanese, we hope this makes your journey even more immersive.

🛠️ Thank you for playing, and we look forward to your continued feedback!

notes.title: The Last Reunion v1.1 Patch
notes.content:
🎉 The Last Reunion Returns with a Deeper and More Immersive Mystery Experience!
This update brings various improvements aimed at enhancing immersion and overall gameplay quality.

📌 Key Update Highlights

Improved NPC Response Quality
└ NPCs now provide more natural and personality-driven answers, deepening the sense of immersion.

Enhanced Emotional Expression
└ Dialogue text colors now intuitively reflect each NPC’s emotional state during conversations.

Optimized Level Design
└ Terrain and structural elements have been refined to reduce lag and create smoother exploration.

New NPC Dialogue Animations
└ NPCs now display expressive animations while speaking, making interactions more dynamic and engaging.


🛠️ We hope this update brings you deeper immersion and greater enjoyment in your experience!
